name: Naith Troop
game_text:
To play, spot 3 Elf companions.
<phase>Skirmish</phase>: Exert Naith Troop to discard the top card of your draw deck. If it is an <culture>Elven</culture> card, make a minion skirmishing Naith Troop strength −2.
flavor_text: Now only the bow and the sword can forestall the coming of the Shadow.
